name: The Cranberries

whyMatters.en: Limerick four with Dolores O’Riordan’s yodel-edged alto: Linger and Dreams (1993) soft-jangle hits, Zombie (1994) distortion protest—Irish alternative that sat on 90s US/UK alt radio beside grunge.
whyMatters.zh: 利默里克四人组，Dolores O’Riordan 带 yodel 边的中高音：Linger 与 Dreams（1993）软 jangle 热单，Zombie（1994）失真抗议——爱尔兰 alternative，钉在 90 年代英美 alt 电台，与 grunge 并列。

lyricQuotes: In your head, in your head / They are fighting
But I'm in so deep / You know I'm such a fool for you

shortBio.en: Limerick alt four; Linger/Dreams soft hits, Zombie distortion protest as 90s alt face.
shortBio.zh: 利默里克 alt 四人；Linger/Dreams 软热单，Zombie 失真抗议作 90 年代 alt 面孔。

body.en:
Formed 1989 as The Cranberry Saw Us; O’Riordan joins 1990. Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can’t We? (1993, Stephen Street) sells Linger and Dreams: Hogan arpeggios, O’Riordan Gaelic-inflected yodel and alto glide.

No Need to Argue (1994) hardens Zombie—drop-D power chords, war/Northern Ireland lyric, louder mix. Peak is Street/Stephen-era early 90s four. O’Riordan dies 2018; catalog remains the 93–94 alt-radio hinge.
body.zh:
1989 年以 The Cranberry Saw Us 组建；O’Riordan 1990 年加入。Everybody Else Is Doing It, So Why Can’t We?（1993，Stephen Street）卖 Linger 与 Dreams：Hogan 琶音、O’Riordan 带盖尔色彩的 yodel 与中高音滑音。

No Need to Argue（1994）硬化 Zombie——drop-D power chords、战争/北爱歌词、更响混音。巅峰是 Street 制作的 90 年代初四人。O’Riordan 2018 年去世；目录仍是 93–94 alt 电台铰链。

note.en: String-tinged soft-jangle; Everybody Else debut radio face.
note.zh: 带弦乐的软 jangle；Everybody Else 出道电台面孔。

note.en: Yodel-edged chorus over Hogan arpeggio; early hit twin to Linger.
note.zh: 带 yodel 边的副歌压 Hogan 琶音；与 Linger 成对早期热单。

note.en: Drop-D distortion protest; No Need to Argue loud turn.
note.zh: Drop-D 失真抗议；No Need to Argue 响度转向。

title.en: Yodel alto over Irish alt jangle
title.zh: Yodel 中高音压爱尔兰 alt jangle

body.en:
O’Riordan’s vocal—yodel break, Gaelic ornament, alto push—is the band ID. Hogan writes arpeggio beds closer to Smiths/R.E.M. than Seattle fuzz.

Linger/Dreams prove soft alternative hits; Zombie proves they can harden without losing her voice as lead instrument.

Stephen Street production keeps drums dry and vocal forward.
body.zh:
O’Riordan 人声——yodel 断裂、盖尔装饰、中高音推进——是乐队 ID。Hogan 写琶音床，更近 Smiths/R.E.M. 而非西雅图 fuzz。

Linger/Dreams 证明软 alternative 热单；Zombie 证明能硬化仍以她人声为主乐器。

Stephen Street 制作保持鼓干、人声靠前。

body.en:
O’Riordan/Hogan brothers/Lawler hold through the 90s peak and later reunions. No classic member fracture in the hit years.

Hiatus 2003–2009; return then O’Riordan’s death ends the vocal era.

Peak unit is the 1993–1994 Street/Argue four.
body.zh:
O’Riordan/Hogan 兄弟/Lawler 撑过 90 年代巅峰与后来重聚。热单年无经典成员分裂。

2003–2009 停摆；回归后 O’Riordan 去世结束其人声时代。

巅峰单位是 1993–1994 Street/Argue 四人。

title.zh: 90 年代 alt 电台爱尔兰面孔

body.en:
Zombie becomes a teaching track for alt protest + drop-D. Later Irish/UK alt cite O’Riordan vocal as regional alternative success path.

Linger remains soft-jangle radio template.

Peer context: grunge volume vs Cranberries vocal-led Irish alt.
body.zh:
Zombie 成 alt 抗议 + drop-D 教材曲。后来爱尔兰/英国 alt 引 O’Riordan 人声作地域 alternative 成功路径。

Linger 仍是软 jangle 电台模板。

同代语境：grunge 音量 vs Cranberries 人声主导的爱尔兰 alt。

interviewQuotes.text: Zombie was anger about the bombs. The loud guitars were the only way to say it.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Dolores O'Riordan

interviewQuotes.text: Linger and Dreams were simpler songs. Her voice did the heavy lifting.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Noel Hogan
